title_candidates: Claude Sonnet 5 becomes the everyday agentic Claude
summary: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5 across all plans, making a more agentic Sonnet model the default for Free and Pro users and available in Claude Code and the API.

primary_source.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Anthropic released Claude Sonnet 5 across all plans.
Sonnet 5 is the default model for Claude Free and Pro users and is available to Max, Team, and Enterprise users.
Anthropic says Sonnet 5 improves agentic performance, including reasoning, tool use, coding, and knowledge work.
The model is also available in Claude Code and on the Claude Platform as claude-sonnet-5.
Introductory API pricing runs through August 31, 2026 before moving to standard pricing.

prerequisites: One task with a checkable result

steps.instruction: Open Claude and check the model picker or default model label for Sonnet 5.
Choose one bounded task that normally takes 20 to 40 minutes, such as summarizing a document or planning a small project.
Ask Sonnet 5 to make a plan first, then approve only the first step.
Compare its result against your source material or checklist instead of trusting the completion.
If you use Claude Code or the API, check pricing and effort settings before moving a repeated workflow to Sonnet 5.
